mission_05: Great work! You have successfully implemented target encoding with smoothing for a high-cardinality categorical feature. You learned how to calculate category-level target means, apply smoothing to prevent overfitting on rare categories, and map the encoded values back to the original dataframe. Target encoding is powerful for features like city, product ID, or user segment where one-hot encoding would be impractical. Always use cross-validation or smoothing when applying target encoding to avoid data leakage and overfitting in production models.
